text:
sanjay: Heads-up — FinCo wants to run a 6-week air-gapped POC. Primary asks: long-term retention of on‑prem bundles, signer rotation, delta patch cadence, and pricing impact for extended retention/support. Need ops/eng/sec input before we send answers.

maria: We ship immutable signed bundles (tar.gz + .sig) and can produce delta patches. Default POC retention is 30 days; enterprise can opt into 1yr archive as a billable add‑on. Key rotation: we can rotate our signing key and publish a new bundle + thumbprint; customer can pin thumbprint to avoid MITM.

josh: Typical cadence we recommend: monthly security updates, quarterly feature bundles. For air‑gapped customers we can push weekly critical deltas if they sign an expedited-hotfix SLA. Delivery options: USB sneakernet, signed chunked deltas, or pre-staged repo snapshot shipped via secure courier.

liz: Pricing note — extended retention and re-signing support increase ops+storage costs. Ballpark: 1yr retention + re-sign on rotation ~= 0.5 FTE support + per-GB storage charge; hotfix SLA (24h) increases seat/support rate. I'll model exact numbers once we lock cadence.

maria: Constraints to flag: bundles are signed RSA-4096 by default. For Private deployments we support customer-supplied signing backed by KMS/HSM; hosted customers cannot supply external keys. For strict no-egress sites we provide an "activate" flow: signed manifest + verification helper tool the customer runs locally.

sanjay: FinCo security questionnaire (extract): 1) Support customer-supplied code signing key? 2) Chain-of-custody proof for transport? 3) Disable telemetry in offline builds? 4) Patch window for CVEs? 5) SBOM availability?

maria: Quick answers: 1) Yes for Private (KMS/HSM) — we need integration details. 2) We provide signed manifests with SHA256 checksums and transport receipts; we can notarize bundles and provide courier chain docs. 3) Telemetry is opt-out for Private and disabled by default for sealed POCs. 4) Patch window: critical CVEs = 7 days for Dedicated with hotfix SLA; standard = 30 days. 5) SBOM and composition reports provided for every bundle.

josh: Example manifest snippet (for ops reference):
```
name: redwood-onprem-bundle-20260210.tar.gz
sha256: abcd1234ef567890...
signature: SIG_v1:base64-encoded-signature
chunks:
  - boot.bin
  - runtime_layer.tar
  - quantized_weights.part1
```
Note: chunking helps if USB capacity or delta patching is used.

liz: Action items: @maria confirm customer-KMS support + rotation doc; @josh draft USB vs delta delivery checklist (incl chain-of-custody evidence); @sanjay update pricing draft and security answers. I'll update SOW template to include retention/patch SLA options.

secbot: Internal checklist: https://redwood.internal/secplaybooks/onprem-signing-checklist (internal) — includes key rotation, manifest format, SBOM template, and courier chain-of-custody examples.

sanjay: If we can confirm KMS + 7-day critical patch SLA we'll move to pricing close. Can we get written answers by EOD tomorrow? :pray:

maria: I'll have definitive answers and the KMS integration steps by EOD.

josh: I'll drop the delivery checklist in #sales tomorrow morning and include the USB packaging checklist.

liz: I'll update the pricing sheet and ping procurement with SOW draft later today.
